name: Dan Eisenberg
bio: Dan Eisenberg was a Bismarck merchant whose traveling salesmen, Will McNaughton and Lee Eisenberg, took orders in Medora during 1884. The paper reported that his house did considerable business in town.

moments.label: His salesman did brisk business in Medora

mentions: Will McNaughton, running for Dan Eisenberg, of Bismarck, put in a profitable day here last Saturday.
Lee Eisenberg, of Bismarck, travelling for Dan Eisenberg, was in town Monday and secured a number of orders.
Lee Eisenberg, representing the house of Dan Eisenberg, Bismarck, transacted considerable business in Medora on Saturday. Lee is a rustler.
